q1: SELECT CUSTOMER_ID FROM CUSTOMER GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT PRODUCT_KEY) = (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT PRODUCT_KEY) FROM PRODUCT)
q2: WITH BASE AS ( SELECT DISTINCT CUSTOMER_ID,PRODUCT_KEY FROM CUSTOMER) ,BASE2 AS ( SELECT CUSTOMER_ID,SUM(PRODUCT_KEY) AS VALL FROM BASE GROUP BY CUSTOMER_ID ) ,ANS AS ( SELECT CUSTOMER_ID FROM BASE2 WHERE VALL=(SELECT SUM(DISTINCT PRODUCT_KEY) FROM PRODUCT) ) SELECT CUSTOMER_ID FROM ANS

explanation: Q1 checks if a customer has purchased all distinct products, while Q2 checks if the sum of distinct product keys for a customer equals the sum of all distinct product keys.
